# Oanduaia

> Forest spa and lodging in the heart of Lahemaa National Park, Estonia.
> Three houses — Sauna House, Pond House and Forest House — in Oandu village,
> Lääne-Virumaa, between forest and sea.

Oanduaia is a small family-run property offering sauna, accommodation and direct
access to Lahemaa National Park hiking trails, including the start of Estonia's
longest marked trail.

## Location
Oandu village, Lääne-Virumaa, Estonia. Coordinates 59.5602, 26.1068.
Inside Lahemaa National Park, near the Baltic coast.

## Accommodation
- Sauna House (Saunamaja) — sauna and lodging
- Pond House (Tiigimaja) — beside the pond
- Forest House (Metsamaja) — in the forest

## Languages
The site is published in Estonian, English and Russian:
- https://oanduaia.ee/et
- https://oanduaia.ee/en
